# Getting help

Three places, one job each:

- **Chat and quick questions:** the **#help** channel of the [BubbleFacts Discord](https://discord.gg/3YS3eWkWrW). Start a thread for each question, so its answer stays with it. Other music content creators and the maintainer read it. Chat is quick but not searchable.
- **How do I…?** Start with the [guide](https://bubblefacts.frolic.org/guide.html), then ask in [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/frolicchris/bubblefacts/discussions/categories/q-a). Q&A keeps the answers and they are searchable, so one answer helps the next person. A Discord answer that others will need gets posted in Q&A too.
- **Something's broken?** In the app, open **Help and troubleshooting** and click **Report a problem**. It fills in your version and recent log lines.
- **A wrong fact?** Click **Wrong** next to it on the dashboard, then **Report it (opens GitHub)**.
- **A security problem?** See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Please don't post it in public.

## Where news goes

Every release and update is posted in [Announcements](https://github.com/frolicchris/bubblefacts/discussions/categories/announcements) and in the Discord **#announcements** channel. The Discord post links to the Discussion, so both say the same thing. The Discord rules are in **#rules**.

## Which versions get help

Only the newest version is supported, including during testing, so please update first: **Update now** in the app, or the [download page](https://bubblefacts.frolic.org/download.html).

BubbleFacts is made by one person, so replies can take a few days. Thank you for your patience.
